1084-4279-6094.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-4279-6094.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-4279-6094.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

5078-5741-7292-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.

2556-5478-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
2556-5478-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Mnemonic Wall and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Mnemonic Wall and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.
2556-5478-5531-5694-8110.notes:
If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Mnemonic Wall and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.
An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

Repeat.

341-1170-5131-6495--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

622-757-3933-5087.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
622-757-3933-5087.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Karn's Bastion to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Kamahl, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

372-2072-2493.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Scrollshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.

Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Archaeomancer and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Archaeomancer trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.

Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.

2775-2919-3192-4214.description:

Activate Utopia Mycon by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Slimefoot, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.

2781-3582-4050-4871-4924.description:

Sacrifice Felidar Guardian to Phyrexian Altar to add one mana of any color.
Felidar Guardian is returned to your hand, and you create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Sacrifice the Treasure token for {W}.
The Spirit dies to having 0 toughness.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Sacrifice the Treasure token for {1}.
Cast Felidar Guardian for {1}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, exile Kaya and return her to the battlefield.
Repeat.

784-1721-2104.notablePrerequisites: Opponents can not block Silas Renn.
784-1721-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation to take an extra turn.
Pay {5}, tap Codex Shredder and sacrifice it to return Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Attack with Silas Renn, dealing combat damage.
Cast Codex Shredder from your graveyard.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

404-1521-2105-4068.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
404-1521-2105-4068.description:
Declare Flamerush Rider, Combat Celebrant and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant, Ghired's second ability and Flamerush Rider trigger.
Resolve the Flamerush Rider trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare the Combat Celebrant token created in step 4 and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may also attack with Flamerush Rider to get infinite copies of any other attacking creatures you control.

1049-1308-2034-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Jirina Kudro is your commander.
You have not cast
1049-1308-2034-4050.description:
Cast Jirina Kudro by paying {1}{R}{W}{B}.
When Jirini Kudro enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, creating two 1/1 Human Soldier tokens due to Anointed Procession.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Human Soldier tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jirina Kudro, adding {W}.
Choose to return Jirina Kudro from your graveyard to the command zone.
Cast Jirina Kudro by paying {3}{R}{W}{B}.
When Jirini Kudro enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, creating four 1/1 Human Soldier tokens due to Anointed Procession.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Human Soldier tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing two Human Soldier tokens and Jirina Kudro, adding {R}{W}{B}.
Repeat from step 5, except that you pay more commander tax each time in step 6, create more Human Soldier tokens in step 7, and sacrifice as many creatures as necessary to pay commander tax in step 8.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Human Soldier tokens, you may activate Ashnod's Altar and Phyrexian Altar any number of times.
